questions.stem_text:
For a given level of government spending the federal government usually experiences a
budget____during economic____and a budget ______during economic_______.
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - surplus expansion surplus expansion

questions.stem_text: According to the quantity theory of money increasing the money supply serves to

options.A: increase long-run output with no significant impact on inflation.
options.B: have no significant impact on either output or inflation.
options.C: lower the unemployment rate while also lowering the rate of inflation.
options.D: increase short-run output but it is the source of long-run inflation.
options.E: increase the nation's long-run capacity to produce.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - increase short-run output but it is the source of long-run inflation.

questions.stem_text: What is the so-called European Economic Community?

options.A: a political union of European nations
options.B: A social welfare collaboration between Eastern and Western European countries
options.E: A trade agreement between Europe and Asia to promote intercontinental commerce

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - a political union of European nations

questions.stem_text:
Economics supposedly deals with the efficient allocation of scarce goods. Where does
scarcity fit in the circular flow model?

options.A: Scarcity is relevant only for non-renewable resources in the circular flow model
options.B: Scarcity is only relevant in the factor markets of the circular flow model
options.C: Scarcity is only considered in the household sector of the circular flow model
options.D: Scarcity is addressed through government intervention in the circular flow model
options.E: Scarcity is implicit in the entire analysis of the circular flow model

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - Scarcity is implicit in the entire analysis of the circular flow model

questions.stem_text: What is the relationship between Net National Product and Gross National Product?

options.A: GNP and NNP are always equal
options.E: NNP and GNP are unrelated financial indicators

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - GNP = NNP + Depreciation
